headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Infosys Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and declaration of interim dividend
summary: Q2 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹49,244 Cr (+10.7% YoY, +2.1% QoQ); EBITDA (derived) ₹11,689 Cr (+10.9% YoY, margin 23.7%); PAT ₹7,838 Cr (+6.3% YoY, +0.8% QoQ).
raw_text: Infosys Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and declaration of interim dividend

derivation.basis_note: Consolidated Statement of Financial Results (PDF p. 18 via vision, reported in ₹ crore). Columns L→R: Col 1='September 30, 2026', Col 2='June 30, 2026', Col 3='September 30, 2025' (mapped Current=Col 1, Previous=Col 2, Year-Ago=Col 3).
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from operations as printed ('Revenue from operations') (excludes Other Income of ₹848.00 Cr) = ₹49,244.00 Cr (Prev Q: ₹48,211.00 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹44,490.00 Cr).
derivation.ebitda_formula: Derived (`derived`): Operating Profit (Revenue ₹49,244.00 Cr − Total Expenses ₹39,029.00 Cr + Finance Costs ₹115.00 Cr = ₹10,330.00 Cr) + D&A (₹1,359.00 Cr) = ₹11,689.00 Cr (23.74% margin; Prev Q: ₹11,409.00 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹10,535.00 Cr).
derivation.pbt_basis: Printed row 'Profit before tax' (no current-quarter exceptional items) = ₹11,063.00 Cr (Prev Q: ₹11,028.00 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹10,229.00 Cr).
derivation.pat_basis: Printed row 'Profit for the period' (Total Consolidated Profit after tax) = ₹7,838.00 Cr (Profit attributable to Owners of the Company/Parent = ₹7,823.00 Cr; Non-controlling interest = ₹15.00 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ crore (Page 18 via vision) · EBITDA derived
